notes.text: Benjamin Netanyahu, nicknamed "Bibi", is an Israeli politician and diplomat who has served as Prime Minister of Israel since 2022.
Having previously held office from 1996 to 1999 and from 2009 to 2021, Benjamin Netanyahu is Israel's longest-serving prime minister.
Benjamin Netanyahu is remembered as a politician connected with Israel.
Benjamin Netanyahu's recorded life dates place this profile around born 1949.
Benjamin Netanyahu is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
